# Train With Riwan

> Private football coaching for players aged 6–18 in Helsinki and Espoo, Finland. Sessions are led by Coach Riwan. The first session is free.

## Coaching and booking

- Format: one coach and one player, with training adapted to the player's age, experience and goals.
- Training focus: ball control, first touch, 1v1 moves, acceleration and changes of direction.
- Monthly package: eight private sessions, usually two sessions a week, for €400.
- First session: free, with no commitment to continue.
- Ages: 6–18, including beginners and players who already train with a club.
- Locations: Helsinki and Espoo. The pitch and time are agreed when booking.
- Website languages: Finnish and English.
- Coach: Coach Riwan.
- Telephone: +358 41 318 5357.
- Email: trainwithriwan@gmail.com.
- Booking form: https://twr.coach/#book
- Finnish booking form: https://twr.coach/fi/#book
- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@trainwithriwan
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/trainwithriwan/

## Common questions

- What does Train With Riwan cost? The monthly package costs €400 for eight private sessions. The first session is free.
- Who is the coaching for? Players aged 6–18, with sessions adapted to their age, experience and goals.
- Where are sessions held? In Helsinki and Espoo. The pitch and time are agreed when booking.
- How do I book? Use the website booking form, call +358 41 318 5357, or email trainwithriwan@gmail.com.
